title: Unable to resize window if "Resizable" is ticked in project settings and project window starts at full size
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible: 4.5.1 stable official, running on Linux Mint (does not occur on Windows 11 running same version)
Update 15/1/26: Also reproducible in Godot 3.6.2, Linux Mint

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Linux Mint 21 (Vanessa) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) HD Graphics 4000 (IVB GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-3340M CPU @ 2.70GHz (4 threads) - 7.65 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm unable to set the window size in code when the window size starts at the same size as the monitor's resolution, and resizable is ticked.  The code has no effect.



### Steps to reproduce

Steps to reproduce:
* Create a brand new project.
* In project settings, set the viewport width and height to be the same as your screen resolution
* Resizable should be ticked by default
* Create a _ready() function and add the single line `get_window().size = Vector2(200, 100)`

If you now run the project NOT in the embedded window, the game window will not resize to 200x100.  If you untick Resizable, it will work as expected.

(I have also managed to get it to resize the window but leave a black rectangle of the original size in the background, but I'm currently unable to ascertain the specific settings I used to get it to do this.  I'll create another report, but I thought I'd mention it as strange things generally seem to happen if the original window size is set to full-size; it's like Godot thinks that because the window starts at full-size, it should go into full-screen mode or something).
